Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Black and Gold Mandala Canvas Print Wall Art, 36" x 36"
Colors: Multi
Materials: canvas
This black and metallic gold piece features imagery of a mandala, known around the world as a symbol of meditation and introspection. It is also a modern yet classic piece of art that will add a touch of glam to your room. Contemporary, metallic print of timeless imagery Hand-stretched canvas on wood. 36" x 36" Ready to hang with hardware included. Made to order
